newsitem.title: USA: Conn. plans to publish tax delinquents on Internet.
newsitem.headline: Conn. plans to publish tax delinquents on Internet.

text.p: Connecticut said on Tuesday it plans to publish the names of the worst 100 tax delinquents, both individuals and businesses, on the Internet on Dec 20.
Tax Commissioner Gene Gavin said he hopes the exposure gives people an incentive to pay their taxes on time.
A spokeswoman for the state tax department said that depending on the results achieved by the program, the state might expand it by publishing the names of more tax delinquents.
"These are people who've been given multiple opportunities to clear their bills," she added.
